decision.purpose: diagnostic design for a future fresh ingress-tail experiment

ingress_tail.top_5_percent_definition: 18 of 360 observations per case and role

interpretation_limits: Each native child has 60 measured samples after 10 untimed warmups; nearest-rank p99 is the maximum sample in that child.
Six paired legs and their quantiles are descriptive; no confidence interval or pooled-sample effect is computed.
Launch order, sample index, phase correlation, and tail co-occurrence are diagnostics only and do not establish cause.
The existing 0964 safety gate remains binding; this evidence does not relax or requalify the rejected screen.

scope.source: valid 0964 epoch2 native raw reports only
